changes: StoryDialogue binds a real ChapterDialogue scene with portrait, monogram, key legend, voice node, history and four authored response-template instances. Runtime response buttons instantiate DialogueResponse.tscn.

Dialogue editor exports include body/speaker/responses/portrait/history and enable toggles. All editor paths skip story resolution, input and voice/audio execution. Authored response samples are retained during editor refresh; extra dynamic previews have no owner.

Compact colors/styles/fonts/focus are serialized in native scene Theme and node overrides. Runtime compact sizing only adjusts count-dependent panel height and portrait text flow, using captured authored geometry and configurable gaps.
FieldUI editor exports affect preview strings only; native HUD layout/theme/gradient nodes remain editable. Runtime labels are set by hosts without ready-time replacement.
HintOverlay uses editable preview rect/spark coordinates/radius and material; editor draw never asks game source; animation remains runtime-only.
Title uses native labels, controls, colors and serialized TitleTheme.tres matching existing Paper defaults; ready no longer replaces node colors/text/theme.
testing: Not run, by delegation instruction. Requires independent fresh-agent validation of editor scene loading, Inspector customization persistence, runtime chapter dialogue/response behavior and music/input editor guards.
